mechanism: Parameter-efficient LoRA variant with frozen projections and sparse masks to reduce cross-task interference
evidence_scope: We propose LoRA with Reduced Interference (LoRI), a simple yet effective approach that freezes the projection matrices A as random projections and sparsifies the matrices B using task-specific masks.
evidence_role: We propose LoRA with Reduced Interference (LoRI), a simple yet effective approach that freezes the projection matrices A as random projections and sparsifies the matrices B using task-specific masks.
